provider_observation: 2026-11-24 authenticated read-only check: prior pilot ID, terminal state, exact tags and existing App matched the registered allocation. An absent or partial hourly gross report never resets the pilot carry.
protocol: One released scientific exec, in-memory capability, volatile exclusive claim. No Modal Snapshot, writable Volume, image build, ports or user network. Finite sleep-only sandbox boot. Accept only complete learning receipts plus their keyed weights and allowlisted stage JSON. Each immutable compressed fragment transferred once, no re-fetch, 64 MiB aggregate inclusive of status and 2 GiB input; charge 3 GiB conservative network allowance. Worker collects immutable deltas about every 15 seconds, client saves locally continuously; preserve available partials, never rerun unknown work. Training deadline uses earliest create-attempt clock (including queue/upload) and expires 75 seconds before object lifetime/discovery cutoff. Exec cap is remaining child time plus 45 seconds. Failed or uncertain provider action leaves the full reservation in place.
